scope: Owned Example window focus and input readiness on installed Windows deployment

example.input_events: Enabled temporarily through the existing development Example argument, then original settings restored

result: Target input acceptance not achieved: Windows did not grant foreground to the owned Example
boundaries: A prior attempt used the older Example without the observer and yielded no input-delivery conclusion.
The updated check stopped before sending input because its foreground prerequisite failed.
Application capture deliberately rejects input when the retained target is not foreground; this guard was not removed.
No global input, input queue attachment, foreground policy, ToDesk setting or unrelated application was modified.
These observations do not prove which external condition caused Windows to reject foreground activation.
